title: Plants: Parts and Needs (KS1)
subject: Science
strapline: The parts of a plant and what a plant needs to grow.
facts: The main parts of a plant are the roots, stem, leaves and flower.
Roots hold the plant in the ground and take in water from the soil.
The stem holds the plant up and carries water to the leaves and flower.
Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.
The flower makes seeds so new plants can grow.
Plants need water, light and warmth to grow healthily.
A seed grows into a seedling, then a young plant, then a mature plant — this is its life cycle.

quick_quiz.q: Which part of a plant takes in water from the soil?
Name three things a plant needs to grow.
Which part of the plant makes the seeds?

teacher_tips: Grow beans in clear jars so children see the roots develop.
Run a fair test: same plant, one with light and one without.
Use correct part names on a real plant, not just a diagram.
